mapper.sql: resolution_id AS resolutionId, hit_id AS hitId, resolution_version AS resolutionVersion, resolution, reason_code AS reasonCode, note, reviewer_id AS reviewerId, operated_by AS operatedBy, on_behalf_of_partner_id AS onBehalfOfPartnerId, resolved_time AS resolvedTime, create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_screening_resolution(resolution_id, hit_id, resolution_version, resolution, reason_code, note, reviewer_id, operated_by, on_behalf_of_partner_id, resolved_time, create_time) VALUES(#{row.resolutionId}, #{row.hitId}, #{row.resolutionVersion}, #{row.resolution}, #{row.reasonCode}, #{row.note}, #{row.reviewerId}, #{row.operatedBy}, #{row.onBehalfOfPartnerId}, #{row.resolvedTime}, #{row.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_screening_resolution WHERE hit_id IN #{id} ORDER BY hit_id, resolution_version
